answer.text: Hi Mia! Let me clarify: a flat is an apartment, and the lift is the elevator. Just to be clear, we put the luggage in the boot, which is the trunk of the car. Jack, arvo means afternoon in Australia, so we meet up at five this afternoon. Let me confirm the plan: we meet at the flat at five, take the lift, and leave together. Does that work for everyone? Please tell me if something is not clear, and we can clarify it again. Sounds good!
accepted: Hi Mia! Let me clarify: a flat is an apartment, and the lift is the elevator. Just to be clear, we put the luggage in the boot, which is the trunk of the car. Jack, arvo means afternoon in Australia, so we meet up at five this afternoon. Let me confirm the plan: we meet at the flat at five, take the lift, and leave together. Does that work for everyone? Hello everyone! Mia, do you mean the flat? It is an apartment in British English, and the lift is the elevator. Jack, arvo means afternoon, so let us meet at five. Just to confirm: we meet at the flat at five and we put the luggage in the trunk, which Tom calls the boot. Does that work for you? Please tell me if you have any other question about a word. Sounds good!

feedback.es: El mensaje aclara dos malentendidos con el equivalente de cada variedad y termina confirmando la hora y el lugar.
